queries.result: First-party results identified Military Lands and Cantonments (ML&C), the KP Revenue Department land-record program, Pakistan Bureau of Statistics GIS material, and a Punjab-only cadastral viewer. No city-specific public Havelian parcel API was identified.

queries.result: No city-specific first-party public parcel viewer or vector endpoint was found. Official/general evidence pointed to cantonment land administration and KP land-record modernization, but not an anonymous Havelian geometry service.

registryEvidence: ML&C is evidenced as the federal cantonment custodian, and the Cantonment Land Administration Rules refer to General Land Register maps. This is general national/federal custody evidence, not evidence of a local Havelian public registry or open parcel service.
uncertainty: A local Cantonment Board, Military Estate Office, or KP land-record office may maintain operational cadastral records not exposed anonymously on the public web. No absence inference is made from failed, blocked, or out-of-scope requests.
